ownership_reason: ReaderBasedJsonParser.nextToken owns the fault. The field it writes is specified in ParserBase: _tokenInputCol is the 'Column on input row that current token starts; 0-based (although in the end it'll be converted to 1-based)', and that single 0-based to 1-based conversion is done for every parser by ParserBase.getTokenColumnNr (col + 1), whose result JsonLocation.getColumnNr documents as 1-based. When nextToken records the token start, _skipWSOrEnd has already consumed the token's first character, so _inputPtr is one past it and _inputPtr - _currInputRowStart is the number of characters of the row up to and including that character (the 1-based column), not the 0-based index the field holds. The variant stores that count, getTokenColumnNr adds its +1 on top, and every reader-parser token column is one too high (the first '[' reports column 2, 'true' at line 2 reports 4). The repository fixes the reading in several places: the byte-stream parser performs the same step with the subtraction (UTF8StreamJsonParser.nextToken and nextFieldName(SerializableString): _tokenInputCol = _inputPtr - _currInputRowStart - 1;), the char-offset assignment two lines above the gold line subtracts 1 for the same reason, and ParserBase.getCurrentLocation converts the index of the next unread character with + 1 ('1-based'). The competitors are correct and pinned: getTokenColumnNr and getTokenLocation are shared with UTF8StreamJsonParser, and the existing passing test TestJsonParser.testKeywords asserts column 1 for the first token of a byte-stream parser, so dropping the +1 (or subtracting 1 in getTokenLocation) breaks it; loadMore's row-start rebasing and _skipLF's row start each move only one line of the trigger (line 1 versus line 2), so neither can make both column assertions pass. Restoring '- 1' in nextToken alone makes the trigger pass with the full suite green; none of the declared one-line competitor edits does.

compensating.why: one-line decoy edit: getTokenColumnNr treats _tokenInputCol as already 1-based (no +1 conversion)
one-line decoy edit: getTokenLocation reports the column one lower
one-line decoy edit: loadMore rebases the row start one character later
one-line decoy edit: _skipLF starts the new row one character after the line feed
